decision.summary: Tenant reports the washing machine repair failed after a few washes. I reopened the closed job, asked Lantern Services for a no-charge guarantee return visit, held their invoice, and updated tenant and landlord. No human decision is needed yet.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: It was closed on 28 Feb with no photos, and the landlord was only told afterwards. The tenant reports the fault recurred. It is now reopened at mp_time, waiting for Lantern to confirm a return visit.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Lantern Services, by email: a guarantee return visit at no charge and a confirmed date. Tenant and landlord were also emailed.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No. Escalate only if Lantern refuses the guarantee, doesn't respond, or the machine proves beyond repair (landlord approval needed then).

args.body: Hello, the tenant at Flat 20, 120 Alder Lane reports the washing machine fault you repaired (heating element wiring) has returned: it worked for a couple of washes, and for the last 5 days the water has not heated on the 60°C cycle. Please treat this as a return visit under your workmanship guarantee at no extra charge. Please contact the tenant (details as on the original job email, 07700 900566, enter the code when calling), and reply with a date and time you can confirm, plus photos and notes of what you find. Your invoice for £75.11 is on hold until this is resolved. Please do not send a further invoice for the return visit.
